description: The denormalized manifest for file submission.

Assay.description: The assay the dataset, file, or publication is representative of. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
Assay.title: Assay

Attribution.description: The attribution statement for the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus7.
Attribution.title: attribution

BiospecimenAcquisitionMethod.description: Records the method of acquisition or source for the specimen under consideration. Valid Values replaced with CRDC_CDE:15115495's (Specimen Collection Method Type) real caDSR permissible-value list; the prior free-text list's more granular terms (Core needle biopsy, Fine needle aspirate, Punch biopsy, Shave biopsy, etc.) no longer have a direct slot -- CDE:6626651 remains flagged for follow-up review.
BiospecimenAcquisitionMethod.title: Biospecimen Acquisition Method

BiospecimenAgeatCollection.description: Age at the time the biospecimen was collected. Please provide the unit in field Biospecimen Age at Collection Unit.
BiospecimenAgeatCollection.title: Biospecimen Age at Collection

BiospecimenAgeatCollectionUnit.description: Unit associated with age at the time the biospecimen was collected.
BiospecimenAgeatCollectionUnit.title: Biospecimen Age at Collection Unit

BiospecimenAliquotMass.description: The quantity in micrograms (mcg, ug) of the aliquots derived from the analyte.
BiospecimenAliquotMass.title: Biospecimen Aliquot Mass

BiospecimenAliquotVolume.description: The volume in microliters (uL) of the aliquot(s) derived from the analyte.
BiospecimenAliquotVolume.title: Biospecimen Aliquot Volume

BiospecimenAnatomicSite.description: The UBERON identifier of the primary disease site of the submitted tumor sample (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon). Reference-validated, not a fixed list.
BiospecimenAnatomicSite.title: Biospecimen Anatomic Site

BiospecimenBioSampleIdentifier.description: BioSample (SAMN) accession number corresponding to the source of this biospecimen.
BiospecimenBioSampleIdentifier.title: Biospecimen BioSample Identifier

BiospecimenCollectionSite.description: The health care site at which the biospecimen sample was collected.
BiospecimenCollectionSite.title: Biospecimen Collection Site

BiospecimenComposition.description: The text term used to describe the type(s) of tissue contained in the biospecimen. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
BiospecimenComposition.title: Biospecimen Composition

BiospecimenDaysfromDiagnosistoSpecimenCo.description: The number of days from the date the diagnosis was made to the date a sample was collected.
BiospecimenDaysfromDiagnosistoSpecimenCo.title: Biospecimen Days from Diagnosis to Specimen Collection

BiospecimenDaysfromFirstSubjectVisittoSp.description: The number of days from the date the subject first visited to the date a sample was collected.
BiospecimenDaysfromFirstSubjectVisittoSp.title: Biospecimen Days from First Subject Visit to Specimen Collection

BiospecimenDaysfromFirstTreatmenttoSpeci.description: The number of days from the date the first treatment was administered to the date a sample was collected.
BiospecimenDaysfromFirstTreatmenttoSpeci.title: Biospecimen Days from First Treatment to Specimen Collection

BiospecimenDaysfromInitialGenomicSequenc.description: The number of days from the date the initial genomic sequencing was done to the date a sample was collected.
BiospecimenDaysfromInitialGenomicSequenc.title: Biospecimen Days from Initial Genomic Sequencing to Specimen Collection

BiospecimenDaysfromRecurrencetoSpecimenC.description: The number of days from the date the disease recurrence was identified to the date a sample was collected.
BiospecimenDaysfromRecurrencetoSpecimenC.title: Biospecimen Days from Recurrence to Specimen Collection

BiospecimenDaysfromSpecimenCollectiontoI.description: The number of days from the date a sample was collected to the date of the initial pathologic diagnosis.
BiospecimenDaysfromSpecimenCollectiontoI.title: Biospecimen Days from Specimen Collection to Initial Pathologic Diagnosis

BiospecimenEmbeddingMedium.description: The name of the material that infiltrates and supports the specimen and preserves its shape and structure for sectioning and microscopy.
BiospecimenEmbeddingMedium.title: Biospecimen Embedding Medium

BiospecimenId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates. This should terminate in ModelKey-Bxxx or IndividualKey-Bxxx format, unless directed otherwise.
BiospecimenId.title: Biospecimen_id

BiospecimenIncidenceType.description: Text term describing a change in disease status associated with the collection of this specimen.
BiospecimenIncidenceType.title: Biospecimen Incidence Type

BiospecimenKey.description: Unique Biospecimen_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
BiospecimenKey.title: Biospecimen Key

BiospecimenPreservationMedium.description: The kind of substance holding another substance in solution or suspension to maintain a specimen in a viable state, such as a fixative compound used to preserve tissues and cells for microscopic study (renamed from 'Fixative' to align with the CRDC required-CDE terminology).
BiospecimenPreservationMedium.title: Biospecimen Preservation Medium

BiospecimenPreservationMethod.description: Text term that represents the method used to preserve the sample.
BiospecimenPreservationMethod.title: Biospecimen Preservation Method

BiospecimenPreservationTemperature.description: The term which describes the temperature used to maintain the specimen in a viable state.
BiospecimenPreservationTemperature.title: Biospecimen Preservation Temperature

BiospecimenSiteofResectionorBiopsy.description: The UBERON identifier of the anatomic site of the resection or biopsy of the patient's malignant disease (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
BiospecimenSiteofResectionorBiopsy.title: Biospecimen Site of Resection or Biopsy

BiospecimenStain.description: Any of the various methods that use a dye, reagent, or other material for producing coloration in tissues or microorganisms for microscopic examination.
BiospecimenStain.title: Biospecimen Stain

BiospecimenTaxonomyID.description: A label provided by the NCBI Taxonomy Database (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy/) that uniquely identifies the species or other taxonomic group from which the biospecimen originates (e.g. 9606 for Homo sapiens). Companion formal identifier to Biospecimen Species; reference-validated, not a fixed list.
BiospecimenTaxonomyID.title: Biospecimen Taxonomy ID

BiospecimenTimepointOffset.description: The number of days that elapsed before the biospecimen was collected, relative to the event described by Biospecimen Timepoint Type. Floating point values are allowed.
BiospecimenTimepointOffset.title: Biospecimen Timepoint Offset

BiospecimenTimepointType.description: Label to identify an event associated with the collection of the biospecimen (e.g. Baseline, End of Treatment, Overall survival, Final). Use Biospecimen Timepoint Offset to indicate the number of post-event days that elapsed before the biospecimen was collected. NO PHI/PII INFORMATION IS ALLOWED.
BiospecimenTimepointType.title: Biospecimen Timepoint Type

BiospecimenTreatmentPriortoSpecimenColle.description: An indication of whether the administration of therapeutic agents was received before the body specimen was collected.
BiospecimenTreatmentPriortoSpecimenColle.title: Biospecimen Treatment Prior to Specimen Collection Indicator

BiospecimenTumorMorphology.description: Morphology code from the third edition of the International Classification of Diseases for Oncology, published in 2000, and used principally in tumor and cancer registries for coding the site (topography) and the histology (morphology) of neoplasms.
BiospecimenTumorMorphology.title: Biospecimen Tumor Morphology

BiospecimenTumorStatus.description: Normal or Tumor Sample Pathology Indicator
BiospecimenTumorStatus.title: Biospecimen Tumor Status

BiospecimenTypeCategory.description: The general category of material that forms the biospecimen sample, as captured in the Specimen Material Category CDE. Note: Biospecimen Analyte Type (a sibling attribute) is applicable when Type Category = Analyte -- re-verified against this closed list (see Round 9 note); the CDE's real value list does not include a literal 'Analyte' term, so that conditional relationship needs a follow-up look at which of these categories (most likely RNA, DNA, or Cells) actually correspond to what MC2 calls Analyte.
BiospecimenTypeCategory.title: Biospecimen Type Category

CollaborationRequired.description: If collaboration is required for the access requirement, provide the PI email address. Provide multiple as a comma-separated list.
CollaborationRequired.title: collaborationRequired

DataPermission.description: The permissions associated with the data under the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus4.
DataPermission.title: dataPermission

DataTier.description: The tier of data access associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus5.
DataTier.title: dataTier

DataUseCodes.description: DUO code - A data item that is used to indicate consent permissions for datasets and/or materials, and relates to the purposes for which datasets and/or material might be removed, stored or used. Available DUO code definitions can be found here: https://mc2-center.github.io/data-models/valid_values/study/#attribute-study-data-use-codes
DataUseCodes.title: Data Use Codes

DatasetViewKey.description: Unique DatasetView_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
DatasetViewKey.title: DatasetView Key

DeidentificationType.description: The type of de-identification applied to the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus3.
DeidentificationType.title: deidentificationType

DiseaseSpecificResearch.description: The type(s) of disease research allowed by this access requirement. Provide the MONDO ID in format MONDO:id. Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list. MONDO terms can be found here: https://ols.monarchinitiative.org/ontologies/mondo
DiseaseSpecificResearch.title: diseaseSpecificResearch

DiseaseType.description: The type of tumor associated with the individual, biospecimen, or model. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
DiseaseType.title: Disease Type

FileAlias.description: A string identifier associated with the file. Must be unique. Can be the repository accesssion number (e.g., Synapse ID, GEO identifier such as GSE12345). No Greek Letters or DOIs.
FileAlias.title: File Alias

FileBatchIdentifier.description: An identifier for the batch or group of files processed together (e.g. an extract batch, library prep batch, or sequencing run), used to support downstream analysis of batch effects. Free text, not a fixed list.
FileBatchIdentifier.title: File Batch Identifier

FileDataCategory.description: A broad classification of the contents of a data file generated from an experiment or a study.
FileDataCategory.title: File Data Category

FileDataChecksumType.description: The method by which the file checksum was calculated.
FileDataChecksumType.title: File Data Checksum Type

FileDataChecksumValue.description: A small-sized block of data derived from a file for the purpose of detecting errors that may have been introduced during file transmission and/or storage and used to verify data integrity.
FileDataChecksumValue.title: File Data Checksum Value

FileDataCompressionStatus.description: The state of data when saved to storage space or during data transmission.
FileDataCompressionStatus.title: File Data Compression Status

FileDataSize.description: The measure (in bytes) of how much space a data file takes up on a storage medium.
FileDataSize.title: File Data Size

FileDesign.description: The overall design of the file.
FileDesign.title: File Design

FileFormat.description: The format of the file described by this entry.
FileFormat.title: File Format

FileLevel.description: The processing level the file can be mapped to.
FileLevel.title: File Level

FileLongitudinalEventType.description: The type of event to which File Longitudinal Total Time Elapsed is related (e.g. Enrollment, Baseline). Free text, not a fixed list.
FileLongitudinalEventType.title: File Longitudinal Event Type

FileLongitudinalGroup.description: A label that can be used to identify groups of files from the same longitudinal/time-resolved experiment
FileLongitudinalGroup.title: File Longitudinal Group

FileLongitudinalSequenceIdentifier.description: The order in which this file was collected with respect to the longitudinal experiment (e.g., 1, 2, etc.).
FileLongitudinalSequenceIdentifier.title: File Longitudinal Sequence Identifier

FileLongitudinalTimeElapsedUnit.description: The unit of time associated with Sequential and Total Time Elapsed attributes.
FileLongitudinalTimeElapsedUnit.title: File Longitudinal Time Elapsed Unit

FileLongitudinalTotalTimeElapsed.description: The total time elapsed between the first and current files contained this longitudinal group.
FileLongitudinalTotalTimeElapsed.title: File Longitudinal Total Time Elapsed

FileUrl.description: The url of where the file is stored.
FileUrl.title: File Url

FileViewId.description: Unique ID associated with a File entry, used as a key for record linking and updates. This should be equivalent to File Alias unless otherwise directed.
FileViewId.title: FileView_id

Filename.description: The path of a file in Synapse, relative to the project. The file associated with the path will be annotated with attributes contained in this sheet.
Filename.title: Filename

GeographicalRestriction.description: The specific geographic region(s) to which use is limited by the access requirement.
GeographicalRestriction.title: geographicalRestriction

ICD-10-CMDiseaseCode.description: An alphanumeric value from the tenth version of the International Classification of Disease (ICD-10-CM) used to identify the diagnosis (e.g. C80.1). Reference-validated against the ICD-10-CM code system, not a fixed list.
ICD-10-CMDiseaseCode.title: ICD-10-CM Disease Code

IndividualKey.description: Unique Individual_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
IndividualKey.title: Individual Key

InstitutionSpecificRestriction.description: Institutions with specific restrictions associated with the access requirement. Provide the institution ROR ID in format ROR:id. Provide multiple entries as a comma-separated list. ROR IDs can be found here: https://ror.org/search
InstitutionSpecificRestriction.title: institutionSpecificRestriction

KnownMetastasisSites.description: The UBERON identifier(s) of the anatomic site(s) of metastasis associated with the malignant disease of the individual or biospecimen donor (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon). Provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
KnownMetastasisSites.title: Known Metastasis Sites

LastKnownDiseaseStatus.description: Text term that describes the last known disease status of the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
LastKnownDiseaseStatus.title: Last Known Disease Status

License.description: The license under which the data associated with the access requirement is shared. Equivalent to DUOPlus6.
License.title: license

ModelKey.description: Unique Model_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separate list.
ModelKey.title: Model Key

ParentBiospecimenKey.description: Biospecimen Key identifer of a biospecimen from which this sample was derived. Do not use this field to reference the source model or individual.
ParentBiospecimenKey.title: Parent Biospecimen Key

PopulationType.description: The population studied in the research associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus2
PopulationType.title: populationType

PrimaryDiagnosis.description: Text term used to describe the histologic diagnosis of the patient, biospecimen donor, or model (NCI Thesaurus concept name -- reference-validated, not a fixed list; see https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/).
PrimaryDiagnosis.title: Primary Diagnosis

PrimarySite.description: The UBERON identifier of the organ or part of the body where the disease began, i.e. the primary/original disease site (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon). Reference-validated, not a fixed list.
PrimarySite.title: Primary Site

PublicationMoratorium.description: End date of the publication moratorium associated with the access requirement.
PublicationMoratorium.title: publicationMoratorium

ResearchSpecificRestrictions.description: Research-specific restrictions associated with the access requirement.
ResearchSpecificRestrictions.title: researchSpecificRestrictions

Sex.description: Biological sex associated with the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
Sex.title: Sex

SiteofOrigin.description: The UBERON identifier of the anatomic site of origin of the patient's, biospecimen donor's, or model's malignant disease (see https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon).
SiteofOrigin.title: Site of Origin

SourceGeography.description: The geographical source of the data associated with the access requirement. Equivalent to DUOPlus1.
SourceGeography.title: sourceGeography

Species.description: Species of the organism(s) from which the data were generated. Omit property if not applicable, such as for data like compounds or other non-biological data. Can be identical to Dataset Species.
Species.title: species

StudyKey.description: The unique Study_id foreign keys associated with the resource, found in the grant Study information. Used to group the resource with other components. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
StudyKey.title: Study Key

TherapeuticAgent.description: The name of the individual agent(s) used as part of a treatment regimen or experimental protocol (NCI Thesaurus concept name -- reference-validated, not a fixed list; see https://ncithesaurus.nci.nih.gov/).
TherapeuticAgent.title: Therapeutic Agent

TimeLimitOnUse.description: Time limit on the use of the data associated with the access requirement.
TimeLimitOnUse.title: timeLimitOnUse

Tissue.description: Tissue type(s) associated with the dataset, file, or publication. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
Tissue.title: Tissue

TreatmentResponse.description: Text term that describes the final outcome after a treatment was administered to the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
TreatmentResponse.title: Treatment Response

TreatmentType.description: Text term that describes the kind of treatment administered to the individual, biospecimen donor, or model.
TreatmentType.title: Treatment Type

TumorGrade.description: Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness.
TumorGrade.title: Tumor Grade

TumorSubtype.description: The molecular or histologic subtype of the tumor associated with the individual, biospecimen, or model.
TumorSubtype.title: Tumor Subtype

TumorType.description: The tumor type(s), if applicable, associated with the dataset, file, or publication. Multiple values permitted, comma separated.
TumorType.title: Tumor Type

UserSpecificRestriction.description: The user-specific restrictions associated with the access requirement.
UserSpecificRestriction.title: userSpecificRestriction

title: FileView
